title: Marie-Pierre C Possible NDE 8405
content: I felt an immense universal love and peace in me. I felt like I was on a cloud, but also in the cloud and I was the cloud. I was filled with a happiness that is not known on this earth. Then my deceased grandmother took my hand to reassure me. Don't ask how I know it, as communication was intuitive and not verbal. I knew that they made me come back because my 7 year old son had to experience an 'important' future, and it is my mission to be with him. I also needed to 'elevate' myself spiritually for my next lives. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 02/01/2014 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Suicide attempt. Life threatening event, but not clinical death. Drug overdose. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I had no doubt. I was like a feeling of peace and universal love, now installed in my DNA. It's more real than our reality on earth. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I was very lucid during the experience. On waking up, I understood that it was anchored at the very bottom of my being and soul. It took me about 2 years before I understood that this was an NDE Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual. Time slightly slowed. Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Tired of life at that moment. I understood that up there was my refuge, my home. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. No noise nor talking, so I cannot compare. I have hyperesthesia since my NDE. [a condition that involves an abnormal increase in sensitivity to stimuli of the senses] Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No The experience included: Presence of deceased persons Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an Unearthly light? Yes I was bathing in this light and was also floating like in a cloud. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place. A cloud in a the middle of nowhere. The experience included: Strong emotional tone What emotions did you feel during the experience? Peace and love never equaled in this world down here. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What importance did you place on your religious/spiritual life prior to your experience? Slightly important to me What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I'm meditating and eating healthy since my experience. I try to change all those bad habits progressively, and the toxins that are keeping me from listening to my celestial body. What importance do you place on your religious/spiritual life after your experience? Greatly important to me What is your religion now? Christian- Mormon. I believe in reincarnation, metaphysics etc. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I was not sure about Life after death. Now I KNOW; no doubts anymore. No fears of death anymore either. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I don't want to work anymore and want to take time for my son and meditation. I slightly fear poverty, but a roof, food and a minimum are sufficient for me. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin The hand of my grandmother took mine and reassured me. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes The angels. Did you believe in the existence of God prior to your experience? God definitely exists During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes The angel of my grandmother, so yes, I believe in protecting entities, and spiritual guides, like Jesus and the prophets are in fact loving spiritual guides. Do you believe in the existence of God after your experience? God definitely exists Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes To live, so that my son can elevate himself intellectually and spiritually. Did you believe that our earthly lives Are meaningful and significant prior to your experience? Are meaningful and significant During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes Yes message I have to come back for my son to accomplish something important .. but what? I do not know but related with metaphysics I think. It is indigo Did you believe in an afterlife prior to your experience? An afterlife probably exists Do you believe in an afterlife after your experience? An afterlife definitely exists Yes Since then, I KNOW that we are reincarnating, and that we are souls before being human beings. Did you fear death prior to your experience? I moderately feared death Do you fear death after your experience? I do not fear death Were you fearful living your life prior to your experience? Moderately fearful in living my earthly life Were you fearful living your life after your experience? Slightly fearful in living my earthly life Did you believe that our earthly lives Are meaningful and significant prior to your experience? Are meaningful and significant Did you believe that our earthly lives are meaningful and significant after your experience? Are probably meaningful and significant Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No Were you compassionate prior to your experience? Unknown During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes Universal love, which is the love of God, guides and angels. Like the total sum of all the love of the universe together Were you compassionate after your experience? Moderately compassionate toward others What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I'm not in the mood to loose my time with skeptics. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Same precision, but not the same intensity felt. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain A more developed 6th sense + hyperesthesia and hypersensitivity. The negative energy of others is draining me. I have to live in solitary to be happy. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? A second chance to allow my child to grow up without to much problems. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes About 2 years and now I only choose connected people in my surroundings, who can understand me. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes Through TV, but like ufologists, I thought this was delusional. And no, it took me 2 years to realize that I had also experienced one. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real Anchored in my deeper self, almost like in the DNA... maybe to elevate even faster in my next life, and to realize everything earlier in order to advance better. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real Now when I see the similar testimonies I feel less alone. Apparently we are 60 million in the world. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? My son has a more karma than usual. This I was told by a well known magnetizer, and even if I'm not directing him towards metaphysics but to general knowledge, I know that what I was told by the angels is true. Every day is proving it little by little. One day I will know the 'why' I'm still here. But there is something exceptional, even though I cannot yet identify his life's path.

arrival.other_being_detail: She reports her deceased grandmother took her hand to reassure her; she also attributes messages to "the angels."

environment.environment_other_detail: She describes being in/like a cloud in the middle of nowhere, bathing in an unusually bright unearthly light.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She reports she was made to come back because her 7-year-old son "had to experience an 'important' future" and that "it is my mission to be with him"; she also says she needed to "elevate" herself spiritually for her next lives.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Catholic (prior); later identifies as Mormon and also believes in reincarnation/metaphysics.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: She reports being/feeling like a cloud and feeling immense universal love and peace; no OBE, no tunnel, no life review, no boundary.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No separation from body and no tunnel/boundary; experience centers on unearthly light, cloud-like realm, unity, and encounter with deceased grandmother/angels, followed by being made to return for her son/mission.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reports: "I felt like I was on a cloud, but also in the cloud and I was the cloud." She also describes the experience as "installed in my DNA" / "anchored" deep within her being.
